Specification: This module defines a very small state machine with a single integer variable x, initialized to 0 and never changed thereafter. Its main purpose is not to model a distributed algorithm, but to exercise an Apalache set-folding construction: it defines a helper operator A(p,q) == p \union {q} and then states an invariant-like formula Inv about ApaFoldSet over duplicated set literals. The comments explain that Inv intentionally asserts the negation of the invariant that should hold, so the specification is meant as a sanity check that the SMT encoding is properly constrained and yields UNSAT.
